$comment: The signed redesign specification. drift-guard compares implementation against this; spec compliance is 15 of the 100 redesign rubric points.
summary: Replace the checkout page with the new design-system flow, behind a feature flag, without changing the order data contract.
in_scope: Rebuild /checkout using the Button, Input, Select and Card components
Add inline field validation with error text associated via aria-describedby
Move the promo-code field below the order summary on mobile
Add a 3DS challenge step for card payments that require it
out_of_scope: Any change to the order data contract
Multi-currency support beyond the existing USD/EUR/GBP enum

acceptance.criterion: The full keyboard path completes a purchase
Order response shape matches DATA_CONTRACT 1.4.0 exactly
Bundle does not grow beyond baseline

risks.mitigation: golden test covers the challenge; flag defaults off

risks.risk: New validation blocks a previously accepted input
risks.mitigation: golden test asserts the full valid-input matrix
